name: WdStyleSort
description: Indicates how to sort styles in the Styles task pane.

constants.name: wdStyleSortByName
constants.description: Sorts styles alphabetically based on the name of the style.

constants.name: wdStyleSortRecommended
constants.description: Sorts styles based on whether they are recommended for use.

constants.name: wdStyleSortByFont
constants.description: Sorts styles based on the name of the font used.

constants.name: wdStyleSortByBasedOn
constants.description: Sorts styles based on the item indicated in the Sort Styles Based On option.

constants.name: wdStyleSortByType
constants.description: Sorts styles based on whether the style is a paragraph style or character style.
